newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 opens weaker as Dow drop hurts sentiment.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 opens weaker as Dow drop hurts sentiment.

text.p: Britain's FTSE 100 started Thursday's session weaker, hurt by a massive overnight slide on the Dow.
The key U.S. index was 40 points off at the London close but ended the day 119.88 weaker at 7,842.43.
The index was 28.2 points off at 4,734.2 after an early plunge for FTSE futures forced the cash market even lower. September futures were 37 points off at 4,736.
However, the market is seen repeating Wednesday's pattern and making up early losses with domestic concerns dominating the market's psyche.
